prompt: Show all students
gold_sql: SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name, email, department_id, cgpa, enrollment_year FROM students;

prompt: Show all students with CGPA greater than 8
gold_sql: SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name, cgpa FROM students WHERE cgpa > 8.0 ORDER BY cgpa DESC;

prompt: List all departments
gold_sql: SELECT department_id, department_name, building, budget FROM departments;

prompt: Show students enrolled in 2023
gold_sql: SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name, cgpa, enrollment_year FROM students WHERE enrollment_year = 2023;

prompt: Average CGPA per department
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, ROUND(AVG(s.cgpa)::numeric, 2) AS avg_cgpa FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY avg_cgpa DESC;

prompt: List all courses with their instructor names
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_code, c.course_title, i.name AS instructor_name FROM courses c JOIN instructors i ON c.instructor_id = i.instructor_id;

prompt: Total number of students per department
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(s.student_id) AS student_count FROM departments d LEFT JOIN students s ON d.department_id = s.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY student_count DESC;

prompt: Show students with CGPA between 8 and 9.5
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, cgpa FROM students WHERE cgpa BETWEEN 8.0 AND 9.5 ORDER BY cgpa DESC;

prompt: Show top 3 students by CGPA with their department name
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, s.cgpa, d.department_name FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id ORDER BY s.cgpa DESC LIMIT 3;

prompt: Total enrollments per course sorted by most popular
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_title, COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS total_enrollments FROM courses c LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON c.course_id = e.course_id GROUP BY c.course_title ORDER BY total_enrollments DESC;

prompt: List all products
gold_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, category, unit_price, stock_quantity FROM products;

prompt: Show all orders
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount, status FROM orders;

prompt: List products with low stock under 50 units
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, category, stock_quantity FROM products WHERE stock_quantity < 50 ORDER BY stock_quantity ASC;

prompt: Top 5 products by total sales revenue
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price_per_unit) AS total_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

prompt: Show completed orders with customer names
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed';

prompt: Total revenue per product category
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price_per_unit) AS category_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY category_revenue DESC;

prompt: List all customers from India
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, city, country FROM customers WHERE country = 'India';

prompt: Show customer name with their total number of orders and total amount spent
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

prompt: Average order value per customer country
gold_sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount)::numeric, 2) AS avg_order_value FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

prompt: Show orders placed in February 2024 with customer details
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount, o.status FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-02-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-03-01';

prompt: List all employees
gold_sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_name, job_title, dept_id, hire_date, salary FROM employees;

prompt: Show all corporate departments with their locations
gold_sql: SELECT dept_id, dept_name, location FROM corp_departments;

prompt: Average salary per corporate department
gold_sql: SELECT cd.dept_name, ROUND(AVG(e.salary)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id GROUP BY cd.dept_name ORDER BY avg_salary DESC;

prompt: Show employees with salary greater than 100000
gold_sql: SELECT emp_name, job_title, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > 100000 ORDER BY salary DESC;

prompt: List employees hired after 2020 with their department name
gold_sql: SELECT e.emp_name, e.job_title, cd.dept_name, e.hire_date FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id WHERE e.hire_date > '2020-01-01' ORDER BY e.hire_date ASC;

prompt: Total headcount per corporate department
gold_sql: SELECT cd.dept_name, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS headcount FROM corp_departments cd LEFT JOIN employees e ON cd.dept_id = e.dept_id GROUP BY cd.dept_name ORDER BY headcount DESC;

prompt: Show the highest paid employee in each department
gold_sql: SELECT cd.dept_name, e.emp_name, e.salary FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id WHERE e.salary = (SELECT MAX(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.dept_id = e.dept_id);

prompt: Total salary expenditure per department
gold_sql: SELECT cd.dept_name, SUM(e.salary) AS total_salary FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id GROUP BY cd.dept_name ORDER BY total_salary DESC;

prompt: Show instructor names and their department budget
gold_sql: SELECT i.name AS instructor_name, d.department_name, d.budget FROM instructors i JOIN departments d ON i.department_id = d.department_id ORDER BY d.budget DESC;

prompt: Show students who got grade A or A+ in any course
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.grade IN ('A', 'A+');
